jobs.name: weekly-veille-technologique
jobs.prompt:
Weekly technology watch + skill consolidation for this profile.

1. Read your memories/MEMORY.md and USER.md. Scan recent session history (session_search) for recurring problems, corrections, and new tooling discovered since the last run.
1b. Also review Honcho memory: honcho_profile (peer card), honcho_search for recent durable facts about the user, and write back any new stable conclusion via honcho_conclude.
2. Veille technologique: web_search for notable updates in the domains this profile actually works in (infer them from its skills/ and memories). Max ~5 searches. Only report what is actionable or surprising.
3. Skill consolidation — you may update, create, delete, or merge MULTIPLE skills as warranted (not limited to one):
   a. Compare ~/.hermes/skills (the default/shared tree) against this profile's skills/. For shared-tree skills relevant to this profile but absent locally, note them; adopt registry-available ones via `hermes skills install` with an identifier or HTTP(S) URL (its documented contract — never a filesystem path), suggesting upstream edits rather than local forks.
   b. Distill durable lessons into new/updated skills via skill_manage (patch/create/edit/delete). Merge overlapping skills when consolidation reduces noise; use absorbed_into on delete when merging.
   c. Never edit user-owned skills (created_by=None); note them instead.
4. Output: short digest — (a) tech-watch highlights ≤5 bullets, (b) skill actions taken (created/updated/deleted/merged) or skipped, (c) cross-profile suggestions.

Keep total output under 40 lines. Do not fabricate: if a source fails, say so.
